the force within the transparent medium coincides with the
direction of the ray. The light at once reappears, but if the
analyser is turned round through a certain angle, the light is
again cut off. This shews that the effect of the magnetic force is
to turn the plane of polarization, round the direction of the ray as
an axis, through a certain angle, measured by the angle through
which the analyser must be turned in order to cut off the light.

turned is proportional-

position at incidence to its position at emergence.

in the direction of the ray.

medium. No rotation has yet been observed when the medium
